title: Imprecate
summary: IM'PRECATE, verb transitive [Latin imprecor; in and precor, to pray. See Pray.] To invoke, as an evil on any one; to pray that a curse or calamity may fall on one's self or on another person.

inlines.v: IM'PRECATE, verb transitive [Latin imprecor; in and precor, to pray. See Pray.] To invoke, as an evil on any one; to pray that a curse or calamity may fall on one's self or on another person.
